entries.name: Mire Crown
entries.environment: drowned peat bog, twisted willows, pale firm peat shelves, dark shallow pools, root arches, fog, tiny amber lights
entries.subject: broad low black ringed leech beast, crown of hollow ivory reed tubes, hooked gripping limbs, green-glowing toothed circular mouth, curled tapering tail

entries.name: Rime Burrower
entries.environment: midnight glacier chasm, vertical blue ice walls, hanging icicles, broad flat frozen lake and snowbanks
entries.subject: rearing segmented pale ice worm, translucent layered ice armor, wedge-shaped head, black mandibles, short ivory digging claws, coiled tail

entries.name: Dune Sieve
entries.environment: moonlit pale salt dunes, wind-eroded sandstone fins at edges, broad smooth sand basin, smoky violet shadows
entries.subject: six-legged desert beetle with overlapping ivory fan armor, huge curved shovel mandibles, fine antennae

entries.name: Spore Cantor
entries.subject: existing

entries.name: Reef Breaker
entries.environment: storm-beaten black sand shore, distant surf and sea stacks, wet sand and tide pools, rust seaweed
entries.subject: massive low armored crab turtle hybrid with barnacled limestone shell, crushing claw flippers, rear webbed feet, kelp, tooth-ring mouth

entries.name: Ember Gullet
entries.environment: volcanic caldera, stable ash platform, distant lava seams and basalt walls, smoke and falling ash
entries.subject: squat six-legged salamander with cracked black ceramic skin, restrained ember seams, glowing throat, ivory spinal plates, thick curled tail

entries.name: Root Widow
entries.environment: abandoned orchard, bare black thorn trees, hanging dried fruit, distant low stone walls, rust leaves and pale earth clearing
entries.subject: eight-legged woody arachnid, split seedpod abdomen wrapped in roots, long crooked thorn-hook branch legs, dried seed husks, amber insect eyes

entries.name: Prism Devourer
entries.environment: smoky quartz cavern, muted amethyst geodes at edges, broad pale mineral sand floor, faint refractions
entries.subject: angular mantis-like insect, four walking limbs, two hooked crystal forearms, smoky quartz armor, diamond insect head, translucent abdomen with warm mineral core

entries.name: Silk Regent
entries.environment: deep ravine with torn ivory silk curtains, overhead web bridges, outer-wall cocoons and black roots, broad taut dust-covered silk platform
entries.subject: tall draped insectoid weaver, four long walking legs, upright ribbed abdomen, hood of ragged burgundy and ivory silk, chitin head and needle forelimbs

entries.name: Sluice Horror
entries.environment: collapsed aqueduct reservoir, broken arches, rusted gates, shallow dark water, broad pale silt-covered dry embankment
entries.subject: blind eel monster with long jaw and needle teeth, barbels, armored body with lime scale and rusty iron rings, broad clawed forelimbs and curled tail

entries.name: Bellback Pilgrim
entries.subject: quadruped with gigantic cracked iron bell shell, chains, small hanging bells, dangling bone charms, four long knuckled ivory limbs

entries.name: Ashwing Matriarch
entries.subject: grounded moth beast, huge upright folded ragged ivory vellum wings with soot veins and burgundy burned edges, feathery antennae, dark hairy body and insect legs

entries.name: Reliquary Crab
entries.subject: asymmetrical six-legged crustacean, weathered carved stone reliquary shell, lanterns, bronze strapping and enormous uneven claws

entries.name: Thorn Seamstress
entries.subject: stooped four-armed seamstress, featureless ceramic face, ragged grey linen, thorn branches, long needle, red thread spools and hooked shears

entries.name: Cinder Colossus
entries.subject: squat broad kiln golem of charcoal basalt and fused iron, glowing furnace chest grate, ivory stone shards, massive fist and iron shovel forearm

entries.name: Wax Revenant
entries.subject: hovering slender wax apparition, hooded featureless darkness, pale dripping candle wax, funeral cloth, burning candles and dangling thin claws

entries.name: Flint Tusk
entries.subject: low heavy boar beast, black flint spine ridge, charcoal hide, huge uneven curved ivory tusks, cracked bone shoulder armor

entries.name: Drowned Oracle
entries.subject: floating abyssal oracle with smoky mantle, broken ivory ceramic crown, pale arms holding a bowl, soft green core and dangling ribbon tendrils and brass charms

entries.name: Carrion Harp
entries.subject: gaunt flightless skeletal bird, tall arched bony harp back with taut strands and small hanging brass charms, long hooked beak, ragged dark plumage and talons

entries.name: Glass Centipede
entries.subject: coiled centipede with raised front, smoky green bottle-glass armor segments, bronze seams, many fine ivory legs, antennae and ivory mandibles
